RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  July 13, 2009/Asadha 22, 1931 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Coal; Corporate Affairs; Development of North Eastern Region;
Environment and Forests; Food Processing Industries; Information and
Broadcasting; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Power;
Statistics and Programme Implementation; Tribal Affairs;
Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
38
Corruption in judiciary
†*121. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of cases of corruption in judiciary are
coming to the fore;
(b) whether Government has looked
into such complaints; if so, the reasons
therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that there is a
lack of transparency at the time of
appointments in judiciary which persists
therein right from the appointment upto
the retirement; and
(d) whether Government would
consider to have ratification of
appointments in judiciary in State courts
done by the State Legislative Assemblies
and in Supreme Court by Parliament?
RGGVY in Madhya Pradesh
†*122. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) the amount to be allocated to
Madhya Pradesh under the Rajiv Gandhi
Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojana (RGGVY)
for the financial year 2009-10; and
(b) by when all the sanctioned schemes
in 29 districts and pending schemes in 19
districts of the State under RGGVY would
be completed?
Illegal mining at Obulapuram in A.P.
*123. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
SHRI NANDAMURI
HARIKRISHNA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has issued a
directive to Andhra Pradesh Government
to stop mining at Obulapuram mines in
that State;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

39
(b) if so, when such order was issued
and the details of that order;
(c) whether the Ministry is aware that
inspite of its directive, mining activity at
Obulapuram is still going on in connivance
with the officials and politicians in the State;
and
(d) what immediate action the Ministry
is proposing to take to stop illegal mining
at Obulapuram?
Joint matrimonial property rights
*124. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a law for joint matrimonial
property rights has been formulated;
and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Protection of Blackbucks
†*125. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of sanctuaries for
Blackbucks in the country;
(b) whether due to heavy rains on 28
May, 2009 in Tal Chhaper Sanctuary in
Churu district of Rajasthan, more than 100
Blackbucks were entrapped in swamp
and died; and
(c) if so, whether any prospective
scheme is being formulated for the
protection of Blackbucks in the sanctuary?
Royalty by ONGC on oil and gas
*126. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR:
SHRI VIJA YKUMAR
RUPANI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether ONGC is required to pay
royalty to the State Government of Gujarat
on crude oil and gas, based on the wellhead
price of crude oil, as per Government's
Notifications dated 16 December, 2004,
20 August, 2007 and resolution dated
17 March, 2007;
(b) whether Government is aware that
during the period from April to December,
2008, ONGC unilaterally paid royalty to
the State Government on post discount
prices;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether the Gujarat Government
has represented to the Central Government
for payment of royalty, as per the aforesaid
notifications and the resolution; and
(e) if so, the action taken by Government
in the matter?
Survey on corruption in judicial
system
†*127. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
rampant corruption in the judicial system;
(b) if so, whether Government has
carried out any survey in this regard;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) how many cases of corruption
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

40
against judges of Supreme Court/High
Courts came to the light during the last
three years and how many cases have been
disposed of, out of them;
(e) whether Government proposes to
establish some mechanism to reform the
judicial system;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Importance of food processing sector
*128. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Minister has pointed
out during his address at the second Food
Technology Summit that the food
processing sector needs 10 years’ tax
holiday;
(b) whether he had also pointed out that
the Planning Commission had not
understood the importance of this sector
and has urged the latter
